title: 2-step Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR)
author: Dana Mozaffari
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7zrhp56

steps.title: Prepare first PCR master mix
steps.instruction: Combine all reagents for the first PCR in a tube using the volumes listed in the Materials section.

steps.title: Program first PCR thermocycler
steps.instruction: Set the thermocycler to: initial denaturation 98 °C for 2 min; 35 cycles of 98 °C for 30 s denaturation, primer‑specific annealing for 30 s, 72 °C for 30 s per kb elongation; final extension 72 °C for 7 min; hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Run first PCR
steps.instruction: Load the first PCR mixture into the thermocycler and start the program.

steps.title: Check first PCR product
steps.instruction: Run an aliquot of the reaction on an agarose gel using the Gel Electrophoresis Protocol.

steps.title: Purify first PCR product
steps.instruction: Purify the amplified DNA with a DNA purification kit according to the kit instructions.

steps.title: Prepare second PCR mix
steps.instruction: In the purified‑product tube, add the gene‑specific primers in the amounts given in Materials, then bring the reaction to the final volume with the remaining master‑mix components.

steps.title: Program second PCR thermocycler
steps.instruction: Set the thermocycler to: initial denaturation 98 °C for 30 s; 10 cycles of 98 °C for 8 s denaturation, primer‑specific annealing for 20 s, 72 °C for 30 s per kb elongation; final extension 72 °C for 7 min; hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Run second PCR
steps.instruction: Load the second‑PCR mixture into the thermocycler and start the program.

steps.title: Check second PCR product
steps.instruction: Analyze an aliquot of the second reaction on an agarose gel following the Gel Electrophoresis Protocol.
